title: Highly Available Redis Service
objective: RDB/AOF policy, replica freshness, Sentinel or Cluster decision, security controls, and recovery runbook.
skills: Redis data modeling and command semantics

milestones.title: Model the problem and guarantees
acceptance_criteria: List inputs, data types, key names, and source-of-truth choice.

milestones.title: Implement a minimal vertical slice
acceptance_criteria: Implement the smallest useful behavior with synthetic data.
Keep connection details in environment configuration, not source-controlled secrets.

milestones.title: Test normal and failure cases
acceptance_criteria: Test missing data, retries or duplicate operations, and cleanup.
Document any static-only check that does not execute Redis.

milestones.title: Operational readiness review
acceptance_criteria: Describe monitoring, persistence and security requirements that apply.
Provide a reproducible runbook and limitations.

required_features: A readable data model and a clearly stated consistency/source-of-truth decision.
A local configuration path that does not commit secrets.
Tests or documented checks for expected behavior and meaningful boundary cases.
A runbook covering version compatibility, safe cleanup, and failure handling.
stretch_features: Add measured cache/latency metrics without inventing data.
Add structured logs with credentials and personal data redacted.
Add resilience behavior only where it is justified by the stated requirements.
tests: Unit tests for pure business logic.
Integration tests against a disposable Redis instance, skipped unless REDIS_URL is deliberately configured.
Manual verification of error paths, resource cleanup, and version-specific commands.

rubric.criterion: Error handling, security and durability boundaries

review_method: Human-reviewed project plus locally executed tests. CodeLeaf’s static exercise grader is not a Redis execution environment; do not execute learner code in the FastAPI process or production web container.
status_note: Project starter is provided for local development only; no server runner or live deployment was exercised during generation.
